site.source: Local summit (4993 m) found in the Moon Trek 30 m LOLA DEM within 4 km of the commonly quoted Malapert Mountain point (-85.99, 357.07). That point sits on the flank: a ridge 100 m north blocks Earth 100% of the time; the summit sees Earth 99.9%.
